title: Fix CI build: unused React import and incorrect InMemoryDriver method
body:
Console `tsc` fails during the `Build Core` CI job with TS6133 and TS2339/TS18047 errors in two test files.

- **`ActivityFeedFilters.test.tsx`**: Remove unused `import React from 'react'` — project uses `react-jsx` automatic transform, no explicit import needed
- **`ReportView.test.tsx`**: `InMemoryDriver` has no `insert` method; use `create` instead. Add non-null assertion on `getDriver()` which returns `T | null`

```diff
-const driver = getDriver();
-await driver.insert('opportunity', { ... });
+const driver = getDriver()!;
+await driver.create('opportunity', { ... });
```
